text: When only a subset of expected components has been delivered, the Synthesizer writes a 'delivery is partial' note in the Cross-Component Interfaces section rather than leaving it empty or omitting the section

The Synthesizer writes a stub doc (src.md in this run) for any component whose sole files are KB error:unparseable, noting the UNKNOWN file and flagging it for human triage — no separate UNKNOWN.md is created when the component field itself is not UNKNOWN
The Synthesizer registers each new Component:<name> artifact individually with aee-artifact add, then commits docs/components/ and .agent-studio/artifacts.jsonl together in one commit before pushing

When the Link Graph unresolved array lists open-end seams (bus.subscribe, cursor.execute, etc.), the Synthesizer describes them in the Cross-Component Interfaces section as open ends, not as confirmed seams, and notes the partner component has not yet arrived

aurora-compute (Go) and aurora-portal (Python) both land under src/payload_plaintext/ — both are synthesized as one 'payload_plaintext' component; the cross-service telemetry bus seam is identified via the secondary literal-match pass and recorded as a crossComponent:true resolved link in the Link Graph

When a previously open-end seam (bus.subscribe unresolved) becomes a confirmed resolved cross-service link in a later run, the Synthesizer moves it from the open-ends table to the confirmed cross-service seams table in the Cross-Component Interfaces section and traces the full producer→consumer data path in Local Data Flow
